import re
import json
from pathlib import Path

work = Path('/home/charl/defiformal-wt-p19-certificates-grok-opus-20260909')
ev = work / 'review/semantic-kernel/certificates/p19/implementation/agy-r25-proof'

stdout = (ev / 'logs/build-verify-16/stdout').read_text()
pattern = re.compile(r'AXIOM AUDIT theorem:\s*([A-Za-z0-9_.\'?]+);\s*module=([A-Za-z0-9_.]+);\s*axioms=\[([\s\S]*?)\]\n(?:info:|\n|Build|warning)', re.MULTILINE)
matches = pattern.findall(stdout)
axiom_map = {}
for name, mod, ax_str in matches:
    axioms = [a.strip() for a in ax_str.split(',') if a.strip()]
    axiom_map[name] = axioms

standard_axioms = {'propext', 'Classical.choice', 'Quot.sound'}

files = [
    ('lean/DefiKernel/Certificates/CanonicalJson.lean', 'CanonicalJson.lean'),
    ('lean/DefiKernel/Certificates/Correspondence.lean', 'Correspondence.lean'),
    ('lean/DefiKernel/Certificates/Roundtrip.lean', 'Roundtrip.lean'),
]

def find_stmt(content, name):
    pat = re.compile(rf'(?:protected\s+|private\s+)?(?:theorem|lemma)\s+{re.escape(name)}\s*(.*?)(?::=|by)', re.DOTALL)
    m = pat.search(content)
    if m:
        stmt = m.group(1).strip()
        return ' '.join(stmt.split())
    return ''

theorems_list = []
canon_cnt = 0
corr_cnt = 0
round_cnt = 0

for file_path, label in files:
    content = (work / file_path).read_text()
    p = r'^(?:protected\s+|private\s+)?(?:theorem|lemma)\s+([A-Za-z0-9_.\'?]+)'
    names = re.findall(p, content, re.MULTILINE)
    for name in names:
        full = f'DefiKernel.Certificates.{name}'
        axs = axiom_map.get(full, [])
        std_only = all(a in standard_axioms for a in axs)
        stmt = find_stmt(content, name)
        entry = {
            'name': full,
            'file': file_path,
            'statement': stmt,
            'axioms': axs,
            'standard_only': std_only
        }
        theorems_list.append(entry)
        if label == 'CanonicalJson.lean':
            canon_cnt += 1
        elif label == 'Correspondence.lean':
            corr_cnt += 1
        elif label == 'Roundtrip.lean':
            round_cnt += 1

std_cnt = sum(1 for t in theorems_list if len(t['axioms']) > 0 and t['standard_only'])
zero_cnt = sum(1 for t in theorems_list if len(t['axioms']) == 0)
forb_cnt = sum(1 for t in theorems_list if not t['standard_only'])

out_obj = {
    'schema': 'defiformal-p19-theorems/v3',
    'theorems_count': len(theorems_list),
    'canonical_json_theorems_count': canon_cnt,
    'correspondence_theorems_count': corr_cnt,
    'roundtrip_theorems_count': round_cnt,
    'standard_axioms_only': (forb_cnt == 0),
    'standard_axioms_count': std_cnt,
    'zero_axioms_count': zero_cnt,
    'forbidden_axioms_count': forb_cnt,
    'modules': [
        'DefiKernel.Certificates.CanonicalJson',
        'DefiKernel.Certificates.Correspondence',
        'DefiKernel.Certificates.Roundtrip'
    ],
    'theorems': theorems_list
}

out_path = ev / 'theorems.json'
out_path.write_text(json.dumps(out_obj, indent=2) + '\n')
print(f'Wrote {out_path} with {len(theorems_list)} theorems (canonical={canon_cnt}, correspondence={corr_cnt}, roundtrip={round_cnt}, std={std_cnt}, zero={zero_cnt}, forbidden={forb_cnt})')
